import { spawn, execFileSync as efs } from 'node:child_process';
import * as cp from 'node:child_process';
spawn('ffmpeg', ['-version']);
spawn('ffmpeg', ['-version'], { windowsHide: true });
efs('git', ['status'], {
  encoding: 'utf8',
  windowsHide: true
});
cp.exec('dir');
const opts = { windowsHide: true };
cp.spawnSync('git', ['log'], opts);
cp.spawnSync('git', ['log'], { ...opts, windowsHide: true });
spawn('explorer.exe', ['C:/'], {
  windowsHide: false // GUI window: the folder the user asked to open
});
spawn('cmd.exe', ['/c', 'echo'], { windowsHide: false });
// spawn('in-a-comment') is not a call
